performerDetails.name: Safiya
performerDetails.description:
Safiya is a rising force in jazz, neo-soul, and reggae, known for her invigorating stage presence and seamless fusion of Afro-Caribbean roots with rich jazz influences. Backed by her dynamic band, she delivers performances that captivate audiences worldwide, blending groove, storytelling, and cultural depth into every show.

A Berklee College of Music graduate, Safiya has earned multiple award nominations, including New England Music Award Jazz Act of the Year in 2022 and 2023 and Boston Music Award Reggae Artist of the Year in 2024. She has performed across the globe, bringing her sound to audiences in Fiji, Colombia, Aruba, Sint Maarten, Portugal, Japan, and throughout the United States.

performerDetails.name: Manindabag
performerDetails.description:
Manindabag is a Boston-based DJ and selector known for driving, genre-blurring sets that bridge underground dance music with raw, high-energy club culture.
Rooted in the grit of the Northeast underground, his sound weaves effortlessly through acid house, driving techno, dark disco, Latin rhythms, and amapiano. Rather than staying confined to a single lane, Manindabag builds dynamic, tension-heavy dance floors focused on groove, track curation, and seamless technical craft.
Whether commanding intimate, dark room takeovers or soundtracking packed club spaces across New England, he brings an authentic, high-impact presence to every booth he steps into.

performerDetails.name: Vaeh Achii
performerDetails.description:
Vaeh Achii is a 21-year-old rising rapper and songwriter from Boston, Massachusetts. Writing and rapping since age 14, she made her stage debut in 2024 and walked away a winner. She participated in Barz Cypha and has continued building her name through live performances, opening for artists including Dipset’s Hell Rell and Boston’s Exit Fame.

Now part of Smokehouse Media, with manager Jay Hunt, Vaeh’s journey as a professional artist begins with proper representation, professional photography, music videos, and live performances. Known for her talent, humility, and family-first mindset, Vaeh often shares the stage with her brother, Asav. While working full-time at the VA, she remains focused on her music and is quickly emerging as a promising new voice from Boston.

performerDetails.name: SeeFour
performerDetails.description:
Boston-bred recording and performing artist SeeFour has been immersed in music since the age of 12. From writing, producing, singing, and rapping his own material early on, he quickly gained local recognition in Massachusetts, impressively winning music competitions against older peers while still attending school. His national breakthrough came on Season 2 of Netflix's "Rhythm + Flow," where his talent was undeniable, earning him acknowledgements from industry giants like Ludacris, Latto, DJ Khaled, Remy Ma, Big Sean and Eminem.
SeeFour's energetic stage presence is backed by a solid foundation of over 200 performances across the United States. His journey has included opening for acclaimed artists like Reason, D Smoke, Tyga, and Jay Rock, electrifying festival crowds, and headlining his own eight-date East Coast tour. Acknowledged within his local scene, SeeFour has been nominated for numerous regional awards. He has also independently released his album, "SPIRIT OF A WARRIOR," via the independent Boston label PUTINWORK Records. SeeFour's commitment to musical growth and his multifaceted talent consistently leave audiences impressed. Experience his journey – SeeFour Yourself

performerDetails.name: A.M. Folk
performerDetails.description: Matt Dodge, Ariel Rabinovic and Matt Savage (formerly of Joy, Coo & Howl, The Subject, Boxcar 5, and 71 Sunbeam) have been making music together for almost 30 years. AM Folk finds them reunited under a new banner with a fresh batch of ramshackle artfolk songs. Loose around the edges but sturdy at the core, the (mostly) Boston-based trio sounds old and new at the same time—with discernible influences tangled up in signature quirks and creative sensibilities honed over decades. The band released its first record, Nil, in Spring 2026—and will be performing in support of it throughout the year.

performerDetails.name: Shotdy
performerDetails.description:
Shotdy — an acronym for Souls Heal Over Time, Darrell Young — is a recording artist and film director whose music lives by a simple, hard-won belief: healing isn’t a wound to rush past, it’s a process worth honoring. The name carries the memory of a close friend, Darrell Young, and doubles as Shotdy’s own philosophy: growth takes time, and there’s beauty in every stage of getting there. Bridging two worlds that never fully understood him separately, Shotdy turns his own story — doubt, purpose, loss, resilience — into what he calls cinema for your ears, music built to feel like a scene unfolding rather than just a song playing.

This year marks a major turning point, with a performance at SXSW and headline stops on tour through New York and Atlanta, carrying his sound to new audiences ready to hear it. At the center of it all is his mission, embedded in the very name of his company: to consistently deliver beyond expectations, giving people the soundtrack to a wild and unfiltered life. Shotdy’s larger purpose reaches past the music itself — he wants people to see that healing your soul doesn’t have to be a hard journey. It can be beautiful, and he’s living proof, one song at a time.

The duo hopes that their music will comfort and inspire others - they play, sing, and write from a place of deep sensitivity and heart.

performerDetails.name: David Kirkdorffer / UNDO
performerDetails.description:
Ambient trippy space.

UNDO is the name I use for my solo performances and recordings.
In UNDO, I play “unguitar” – a rather nerdy term I made up in 1992 to describe my approach to my ambient guitar playing. The term tries to capture two ideas for me: 1) that in UNDO I try to just follow instincts rather than “do” ideas; and 2) while I play guitar, what you hear doesn’t really sound like a guitar as I use little pedals and delays to make very un-guitar-like sounds.
Generally, my themes slowly evolve and intertwine, allowing a listener to use the music as a soundtrack to the images playing in their head. I like it when listeners have their own mental imagery to accompany their experience of this music. Bring your consciousness however you will.

performerDetails.name: Sol y Canto
performerDetails.description:
This award-winning Latin husband and wife duo features Puerto Rican/Argentina Rosi Amador’s crystalline voice and New Mexican Brian Amador’s lush Spanish guitar and inventive compositions. Accompanied by their newest band member, The Amadors are thrilled to be joined by Sol y Canto’s newest member, Brian Urra. Brian is a Chilean jazz violinist and vocalist who blends jazz, soul, and contemporary classical improvisation with the rich influences of his Chilean heritage and Latin American roots. He brings a fiery energy and presence through both his expressive violin playing and lush harmony vocals that weave seamlessly alongside the Amadors,  breathing new life into the band’s lyrics.

Sol y Canto’s original songs and fiery Latin classics touching on infatuation, hope, social justice, love and whimsy in genres ranging from lively dance rhythms to gentle ballads, featuring gorgeous harmony vocals, Spanish guitar, cajón and bongos. They are three-time winners of Boston's Music Awards as Latin Artists of the Year.
